title: Who Knew (Grinch's Redemption) (Remastered)
lyrics:
[Verse]
Creepin' through the town, sack on my back,
Grinch on the mic, heart black as the track.
Thought the loot was the root, stole it all in a flash,
Tinsel, bows, roast beast, even snatched the stash.
Cindy Lou caught me, wide eyes, no fear,
Said, "Why you takin' Christmas? What's your deal here?"
I froze, little Who, droppin' truth like a preacher,
Taught me love ain't in the gifts—it’s the people that teach ya.
[Chorus]
Who knew? Cindy Lou knew.
Presence, not presents, that's the real truth.
Who knew? Cindy Lou knew.
My heart grew, ‘cause the love came through.
[Verse 2]
Mount Crumpit vibes, I was king of the cold,
Thought the glitter and gold was the key to the soul.
Turns out, nah, it was deeper than that,
It’s the hands that hold you when the world turns flat.
Cindy saw me clear, no hate in her eyes,
Said, "Grinch, come and join us, don't live in disguise."
So I slid back to Whoville, bag
in my clutch,
But this time, it was hearts I was tryna touch.
[Chorus]
Who knew? Cindy Lou knew.
Presence, not presents, that's the real truth.
Who knew? Cindy Lou knew.
My heart grew, ‘cause the love came through.
My heart grew, ‘cause the love came through.

title: 49 (Remastered)
lyrics:
[Verse]
Lights are bending time is slow
Snowflakes melting start to glow
A reindeer laughs but no one's there
I hear whispers in the frosty air
[Chorus]
Christmas in the ether
Echoes in my head
Christmas in the ether
Colors turn to red
Christmas in the ether
Did it snow or was it said
[Verse 2]
Pine trees breathing in the haze
Northern lights begin to blaze
The ground is shaking is it real
Or is it just the bass I feel
[Prechorus]
Holograms of candy canes
Pixel stars in endless chains
[Chorus]
Christmas in the ether
Echoes in my head
Christmas in the ether
Colors turn to red
Christmas in the ether
Did it snow or was it said
[Bridge]
I’m falling up the chimney now
The sky is dripping I don’t know how
Sleigh bells crash like cymbals loud
The moon’s a disco ball in clouds

title: Candy Cane Chaos
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pull up to the block, it's a sugarcube war
Whole front yard loud like a cartoon store
Icicles swing, got a grin on the roof
One plug on the line and the whole town moot
Grandma in the window like, "Baby, that's a lot"
I said, "I know, I like it spicy, why not?"
Candy canes doing tricks, red and white flex
One elf got a tan, he got no regrets
[Pre-Chorus]
Count it down, count it down
Hold that breath
Everybody lean in
Feel that mess
The whole fence shaking
Like it's got a pulse
One more second
Then we lose control
[Chorus]
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Candy cane chaos, start the show
Lights go wild, lights go bold
Candy cane chaos, let it roll
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Hold that pose, then drop it low
Big bright chaos, center stage
Candy cane chaos, Christmas rage
[Drop]
Brrr-brrr, oh-oh
Spin that pole, let it go
Brrr-brrr, oh-oh
Boom on cue, steal the snow
[Verse 2]
Got a sled on the lawn with a gold chain too
Mrs. Claus on the step like, "You know what you do"
One reindeer blinking like he just got paid
And the snowman smirks with a suit too tailored
Kids at the curb like, "How's it move like that?"
I said, "Baby, it's a secret, don't ask the cat"
Some things glow hard, some things shine harder
Whole setup dressed up like a North Pole charmer
[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up
Feel that grin
Bells in the air
We diving in
Every bulb ready
For the final hit
Little hush now
Here it is
[Chorus]
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Candy cane chaos, start the show
Lights go wild, lights go bold
Candy cane chaos, let it roll
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Hold that pose, then drop it low
Big bright chaos, center stage
Candy cane chaos, Christmas rage
[Bridge]
[Beat Breakdown]
Tiny little twinkles on the porch swing
Then the whole house crack when the bass ring
Cookie tray shook, got a side-eye from mom
I said, "That's the sauce, don't call it a bomb"
Oh, oh, wait for it
Hold your laugh, don't quit
One more flash, one more spark
Then we light up the dark
[Final Chorus]
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Candy cane chaos, start the show
Lights go wild, lights go bold
Candy cane chaos, let it roll
Hit that switch, watch it blow
Hold that pose, then drop it low
Big bright chaos, center stage
Candy cane chaos, Christmas rage
[Outro]
Brrr-brrr, oh-oh
Keep it cute, keep it cold
Brrr-brrr, oh-oh
Whole block lit, story told
